lines.text: Absalom invited the king's sons to his sheepshearing at Baal-hazor, and David finally sent Amnon with them.
Absalom ordered his young men to kill Amnon when his heart was merry with wine, and they did.
Each of the other sons fled on his own horse, and David tore his clothes at the report.
Jonadab told David only Amnon was dead, and then the king's sons arrived wailing loudly.
Absalom fled to Talmai, the king of Moab, and stayed there three years.
